subject: Renewal portal cutover & procurement authorization for Nimbus renewal
messages:
From: Kate Bryant <kate.bryant@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Chloé Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Next steps for renewal — procurement portal & onboarding refresh

Hi Chloé,

Hope you’re well — heading into our renewal window and procurement has asked for a short checklist so we can close before our fiscal cutoff (end of April). Two asks from our side: 

1) A link to Redwood’s procurement portal so procurement can upload the PO and required forms.
2) An updated quote that shows a 24-month term with the proposed capacity ramp (25% increase in month 1, then staged increases to month 12). Procurement also needs to know whether billing can be quarterly instead of monthly.

I’ve attached our standard PO requirements for your finance team. Can you loop in the right people on your side and confirm the portal cutover path?

Thanks —
Kate
Kate Bryant
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Cloud
procurement@nimbuscloud.com

Attachment: nimbus_po_requirements.pdf

From: Chloé Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Bryant <kate.bryant@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-28T17:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps for renewal — procurement portal & onboarding refresh

Hi Kate — thanks for the note and the attached PO checklist. Looping in Jordan (Sales Ops) and Laura (Finance/Procure enablement) to map the exact handoffs. Proposed runbook below; please flag anything missing: 

Mutual action plan (high level):
- Redwood: generate an updated quote (24-month term) and a ramp schedule PDF; push a pre-approved PO lane to the portal. (Owner: Chloé, ETA: 48 hrs)
- Sales Ops: create a pre-filled PO template and enable the "partner approval" lane in the procurement portal so Nimbus procurement can upload PO directly. (Owner: Jordan, ETA: 24–48 hrs)
- Finance: confirm quarterly billing cadence is supported for this contract and note any SSO/KYC artifacts required. (Owner: Laura, ETA: 72 hrs)

We can also add a short DocuSign flow for the amended master services agreement (MSA) with the term change. I’ve attached the working quote and a mutual_action_plan workbook for tracking.

Action items for Katie/Nimbus:
- Confirm fiscal start date you want on the 24-month term (calendar date or end of fiscal month).
- Confirm billing cadence preference (monthly vs quarterly).

I’ll stand by for confirmation and will send the portal link once Jordan has the lane provisioned.

Best,
Chloé Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai

Attachments: redwood_quote_2028_Q2.pdf; mutual_action_plan.xlsx

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Chloé Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Kate Bryant <kate.bryant@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-29T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Procurement portal lane + pre-approved PO template

Hi all — I’ve provisioned the Nimbus lane in the Redwood procurement portal and uploaded a pre-filled PO template that matches the 24-month term + staged capacity ramp you described. Portal link: https://app.redwood.ai/portal/onboard/DW-3948 (see "Nimbus - PreApproved" lane).

Notes:
- Pre-approved PO template (po_template.xlsx) includes the capacity schedule you requested. If procurement prefers a single lump PO we can accept that, but the template expects staged delivery/credits to match the ramp.
- Bill cadence: Finance has tentatively confirmed quarterly invoicing is supported for committed capacity; Laura will confirm any additional paperwork.
- DocuSign: I’ll kick off the MSA amendment once Kate confirms the fiscal effective date.

Attachments uploaded to portal: po_template.xlsx; procurement_portal_onboard_steps.docx

Jordan Blake
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.ai

From: Kate Bryant <kate.bryant@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Chloé Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbuscloud.com
Date: 2028-03-29T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement portal lane + pre-approved PO template

Thanks, Jordan — that looks straightforward. A couple quick clarifications from procurement: 

- Fiscal alignment: We prefer the term to start 2028-05-01 (start of our new fiscal period). If the MSA amendment reflects a 2028-05-01 start, we can route an executed PO right away.
- Billing cadence: Quarterly invoicing works, but procurement requires an attestation of data residency controls attached to the PO for our compliance team.

I’ve attached our internal attestation template — can Redwood populate and upload the attestation when the PO lane is triggered? Once that’s in place, procurement will upload the signed PO to the portal and request an expedited review.

Appreciate the help — Kate

Attachment: attestation_template.docx

From: Chloé Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Bryant <kate.bryant@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-30T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Procurement portal lane + pre-approved PO template — confirmation and next steps

Kate — confirmed. Summary and final ask list before portal upload: 

1) Effective term start: 2028-05-01 (we will reflect this date in the MSA amendment and the PO template).
2) Billing cadence: quarterly (Finance will invoice in arrears on the quarter schedule; Laura to confirm invoicing address/formats).
3) Data residency attestation: Redwood will populate the attestation_template.docx and upload it to the Nimbus lane prior to allowing PO fulfillment. (Owner: Laura, ETA: 48 hrs)
4) DocuSign: I will approve the MSA amendment and sign the Redwood side; Jordan will then publish the DocuSign envelope for Nimbus signature once the attestation is in the portal.

Timelines: Jordan to enable lane and confirm DocuSign flow today; Laura to upload the populated attestation and final invoice terms by EOD Friday (2028-04-01). Once Nimbus uploads the signed PO we’ll route for expedited provisioning and schedule capacity ramp on the agreed cadence.

If this matches your expectation, I’ll mark the mutual_action_plan row as "Procurement lane created; awaiting PO" and loop back when the DocuSign envelope is live.

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out quickly.

Chloé Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
chloe_martin@redwood.ai

Related links: https://app.redwood.ai/portal/onboard/DW-3948 ; https://www.docusign.com/Redwood/DW-3948
